title: Valkor Sync
description: Reward Discord Nitro boosters in Minecraft through secure verification codes and automated in-game rewards. Sync Discord boosts with customizable commands, cooldowns, and one-time claim support.
body:
# Valkor Sync

Valkor Sync is a lightweight and professional Minecraft plugin that rewards Discord Nitro boosters directly in-game. It allows players to verify their Discord boost status using a secure code system, then instantly receive configurable rewards on your server.

Designed for communities that want to connect their Discord server with Minecraft perks, Valkor Sync offers a simple setup, fast performance, and a clean player experience.

## Features

- Reward Discord Nitro boosters automatically
- Secure verification code system
- Configurable reward commands
- One-time claim or repeat claim support
- Cooldowns to prevent abuse
- Async tasks for better performance
- Customizable messages
- Admin reload command
- Lightweight and optimized
- Supports Minecraft 1.21 - 1.21.11

## Commands

- `/booster` - Generate a verification code
- `/boostsync help` - View plugin help
- `/boostsync reload` - Reload configuration

## Permissions

- `boostsync.booster`
- `boostsync.admin`
- `boostsync.reload`
- `boostsync.bypass.cooldown`
- `boostsync.bypass.onetime`

## How It Works

1. Player joins the Minecraft server
2. Player runs `/booster`
3. A secure verification code is generated
4. Player sends the code to your Discord bot
5. BoostSync verifies the Discord boost
6. Rewards are automatically given in-game

## Perfect For

- Survival servers
- SMP communities
- Network servers
- Discord-based communities
- Servers wanting booster perks

## Performance

BoostSync is built to be lightweight and efficient with async processing to reduce server lag and keep everything running smoothly.

## Support

If you need help setting up BoostSync or reporting issues, contact the project owner.
